canonicalProcedure.admission: Self only; no recipient conversion. A live effective alignment resolver supplies independent Order and Moral axes after legitimate Lock/Anchor/protection. Preserve underlying alignment histories. Undefined/protected is not Neutral.

body.sizeAnatomy: retain original occupied bounds, anatomy, limbs, hands, mass, physical support and senses
body.appearance: visible energy form; appearance never reveals an otherwise protected axis
body.hp: retain exact current/max HP, Wounds, zero/death and all injury history; no second bar, refill or replacement life
body.equipment: all real equipment remains worn/carried at its current stable attachment; focus/armor/capacity unchanged
body.basePermissions: ordinary movement, physical collision, attacks and lawful casting remain; no flight, incorporeality, immunity, planar access or extra turn

moralAxis.undefinedOrProtected: energy strike unavailable; ordinary actions remain

energyStrike.cost: one actual Action; not a spell cast
energyStrike.target: one perceived creature within60ft and clear LoE
energyStrike.resolution: one spell attack using the owning cast's legal attack bonus
energyStrike.damage: 4d10 of the current permitted Moral-axis type; ordinary target mitigation and dealer attribution apply
energyStrike.dealer: the transformed actor, not a separate creature

insight.cost: one actual Action; not a new cast or extra RP cost
insight.target: one perceived creature within120ft and clear LoE
insight.output: Only that target's permitted current effective Order/Moral axes, each with as-of time; no underlying conduct, private memories, alignment cause or genealogy
insight.protection: Covered/unknown axis yields identical No information available; do not reveal which reason. Never force a save or create public sigils borrowed from another spell
insight.cadence: one query per actual Action; no passive refresh

lifecycle.printedInstantaneous: initiation only; finite continuing form is a NEW explicit spell-local interpretation, not a native source claim
lifecycle.starts: legal commitment; interrupted cast ends its attempted concentration with paid costs intact
lifecycle.axisUpdates: reevaluate immediately before each affected action/check; changes remove old modifiers before adding new ones
lifecycle.ending: concentration loss/incapacity/death/eligible dispel/replacement/elapsed deadline ends the form; no HP/history reset
lifecycle.suppression: covered ongoing expression inactive, clock continues; resume only if source still active, no catch-up attacks
lifecycle.safeReturn: same physical bounds throughout; current body/equipment/support retained, no repositioning rescue or restored gear
lifecycle.stacking: one Ascension form per actor; successful newer form replaces older, never adds bonuses twice

canonicalProcedure.retainedProcedure: sources/repo/DescentReviewChanges/ReviewBible/data/public/spell_candidates/rank9knowledgerevelation5_reviewed_198/procedures/faction-omniscience-supreme.json#/procedureContent; FO198-ADMISSION, dossier, 168-hour forecast, protection and focused retrieval remain controlling.
canonicalProcedure.admission: Name one exact distinguishable institution ID already known to the caster; choose one willing perceived recipient within 120 ft and LoE. No nearby member, positive reputation, membership or rank-7 feed prerequisite. Unknown/nonexistent institution resolves after payment to the same neutral No information available result as inaccessible evidence.

inputSchema.institution: stable ID, aliases with effective dates, predecessor/successor links with evidence, observation timestamp
inputSchema.fact: stable fact ID, institutional subject/relation, fact/report/belief classification, value, validAt/recordedAt, source ID/version, disclosure audience, plane-access permission, protection operand
inputSchema.forecastInput: versioned plans, constraints and tendencies actually known at observation; no seeded future state as proof

canonicalProcedure.query: Produce the complete permitted institutional record at observation, including remote same-plane branches and history. Do not replace the dossier with one sample. A missing record is unknown, not affirmative absence. Separate independently accessible institutional records from any protected personal fact they might otherwise corroborate.
canonicalProcedure.privacy: Output only permitted facts and their actual record provenance. Never expose hidden roster size, omitted count, hidden index gaps, protective diagnosis or a protected person's current truth through an institutional relabeling. A direct unavailable query returns No information available without cause. Public report text remains labeled report rather than validated personal truth.
canonicalProcedure.prediction: Horizon is [observation,observation+604800000 ms]. Every supported likely development is included with evidence IDs, assumptions, alternatives and qualitative uncertainty. Deterministic given the same versioned inputs. No numeric probability unless an independently bound model supplies it; no compulsion of future actors.
canonicalProcedure.memoryAndRetrieval: Resolution grants the timestamped permitted dossier to the selected recipient only. It is ordinary acquired memory thereafter. Focused tactical retrieval costs one Action, or 6000 ms of focused work outside initiative; ordinary recognition/communication uses shared rules. No ongoing source, refresh, remote live feed or dispel erasure.

entries.name: Faction Incarnate

canonicalProcedure.admission: Perceived empty, supported spawn within 120 feet and line of effect; the nominated faction has a stable ID known to the caster. Invocation requires the caster to be a recorded member, current standing of at least +1, and an active explicit invocation-permission record. These requirements do not derive from class access or unrelated spells.
canonicalProcedure.factionInput: A versioned faction-power registration selects one of the spell-owned profiles below and supplies explicit permission for that selection. The spell does not create a faction, leader, memory, treasury, or general magical permission.

body.anatomy: two legs, two hands, head; physical solid body
body.saves: owner proficiency bonus as the explicit ordinary-summon default; no additional ability modifier
body.language: understands owner commands; no institution knowledge or ungranted language
body.gear: none at creation; attack is intrinsic; a real borrowed item remains real and separately owned

strike.cost: one commanded damaging Action, shared owner offense allowance
strike.target: one perceived creature at5ft, clear LoE

guard.effect: +2 typed Incarnate AC until next owner regular START or source ending, whichever first; no concentration, no HP gain
guard.stacking: strongest same-stat flat bonus rule, no stacking duplicate

carryOrHandoff.cost: ordinary actual item-handling Action in attached phase, under command
carryOrHandoff.limits: hands,200lb/10Load, reach5ft, real source item custody/weight; never automatic pickup at summon

canonicalProcedure.command: Owner spends real Bonus Action within60ft and perceived by companion. Consume owner companionCommandRound at commitment; execution occurs only in the attached phase after the complete owner turn. Consume companionOffenseRound only for damaging action execution. Clear pendingCommand on the attempt and retain consumed receipt; never replay a cancelled/attempted order. No independent regular turn or free Reaction.
canonicalProcedure.default: With no valid command, the creature takes only supported movement up to its current budget and Dodge. It does not guard, strike, or transfer items without a command.
canonicalProcedure.healingAndDeath: This living Elemental can receive an ordinary HP-healing source only if that source permits Elementals or summoned creatures. Healing is clamped to 100 HP; injuries and deadlines persist. Ordinary 0 HP or a source-authorized terminal Null result ends its existence; it leaves no reusable corpse, loot, or death-resource trigger. Provider-specific behavior must be authorized by that provider’s own rule.

lifecycle.standingLoss: standing below+1 or membership lost cancels queued command and denies new commands; body remains default until original deadline unless invocation permission itself is revoked
lifecycle.permissionRevocation: ends manifestation immediately; no source refund
lifecycle.suppression: body and source traits suppressed according to provider locus; no orders while unavailable; deadline keeps running; resume cannot restore cancelled command
lifecycle.recast: new successful source replaces prior body, settles real cargo once and does not reset owner-round budgets
lifecycle.ending: intrinsic body/force strike ends; real cargo drops at current exact bounds and follows real support/fall settlement; guard ends, source IDs retained in history

profiles.tradeoff: no guard action; movement remains supported physical walking, not flight/teleportation

canonicalProcedure.admission: One willing perceived target within 120 feet and line of effect, plus one distinguishable faction ID. Resolve any relationship from an authoritative source record; the spell does not create or infer membership, office, or institutional services.
canonicalProcedure.standing: On successful resolution write the selected target/faction current standing to the established maximum +3. Append a spell-caused standing event with old value/version. Do not erase conduct, debts, sanctions or history; do not grant membership, office, alliance or Incarnate invocation. Later real misconduct can lower standing normally.

significantBenefit.classification: NEW spell-local benefit, not an institution resource or copied faction service
significantBenefit.grant: Create one finite entitlement for this target/faction pair if none was ever granted or consumed. A new legitimate externally granted entitlement would require its own source record; recasting cannot manufacture one.
significantBenefit.key: targetID:factionID:FactionReserve-40; durable across source endings, replacement, load/save and recasts
significantBenefit.activation: Target spends one real Action while alive, willing and standing with that faction is currently+3. It gains40 temporary HP under the shared nonadditive temporary-HP rule. Consume entitlement at legal activation even if a stronger temporary-HP pool means no increase. No RP recovery or healing.
significantBenefit.window: Entitlement expires at initial successful resolution+86400000ms; actual granted temporaryHP expires at that same deadline or earlier depletion/death. No clock refresh on recast.
significantBenefit.source: rank9 ongoing benefit expression after instantaneous standing update; no concentration
significantBenefit.suppression: Only unconsumed entitlement activation/remaining granted magical tempHP is unavailable while covered; consumed/depleted counts stay consumed, deadline continues. Resumption exposes only remaining pool, never original40.
significantBenefit.revocation: Standing below+3 disables unconsumed activation and suppresses remaining benefit until+3 or expiry; standing restoration cannot refill it.

canonicalProcedure.repeatAndDeath: New paid casts may set current standing to+3 again but do not erase intervening misconduct or reset the unique entitlement. Completed standing updates are not reversed by dispelling the benefit. Death ends remaining tempHP and entitlement with real corpse/equipment unchanged.

canonicalProcedure.durationDecision: Until dispelled creates a removable pending purification expression through resolution. On success, end every eligible existing corruption application and end the expression; it grants no continuing ward or future immunity. Dispelling later cannot restore removed applications.

admission.creature: One actually willing perceived creature within120ft/LoE; unwilling or hidden consent is not presumed.
admission.area: NEW sphere radius30ft centered at a perceived point within120ft/LoE; enumerated physical area expressions only. A living occupant is not purified merely for standing inside; any creature treatment uses that individual's explicit consent and creature-mode admission in a separate cast.
admission.shapeRule: Source-independent divisible environmental cells are clipped to sphere intersection by exact geometry. Indivisible components require complete manifestation containment and the source removal permission. Partial overlap does not authorize whole remote-source deletion.

matrix.action: end every eligible unprotected active application by stable ID and real callback
end eligible exposed components only; protect independent and higher-priority restricted parents; ordinary rank alone does not bypass explicit protection
set current source-defined removable burden to0; preserve historical maximum, acquisition log and any nonremovable component; explicitly classify each contributing application
remove current reversible exposure-derived stage and its source-owned active symptoms once; preserve past exposure history, completed anatomy/injury and independent obligations
do not delete knowledge or knowledge-derived history/stage; end only separately eligible active corruption symptom sources, never the knowledge itself
execute that component's exact end callback; do not heal unrelated HP/Wounds or reverse completed physical consequences
preserve; intrinsic Oracle Curse/Burden is not generically removable
preserve its three existing cure routes only: mask confession, Archon temporary blessing, bitter-sap antidote. This spell is not a fourth route

canonicalProcedure.algorithm: Snapshot eligible application graph and versions after paid resolution checks. Compute deterministic affected component/cell set; apply each end once atomically, append irreversible in-world removal receipts. Keep remote generator active unless separately eligible and contained. Retry returns receipt before reevaluating the old graph. Later exposure requires a new source-generated application ID; never revive a removed one.
canonicalProcedure.preservation: Keep alignment, ancestry, ordinary damage types, acquired knowledge, current HP/maxHP/Wounds/dead-alive, real anatomy, inventory/ownership and histories unless an exact eligible source end callback explicitly owns a temporary component.

canonicalProcedure.admission: Caster plus an explicitly enumerated finite set of willing, conscious, living physical companion actors perceived within120ft/LoE; no fixed party cap. Each must possess an original body and be able to give consent. NEW exclusions: already-projected actors, dead remains, unconscious actors, summoned transient bodies and wholly incorporeal actors are not eligible in this model. This is a spell-local eligibility choice, not a global creature rule.
canonicalProcedure.siteAuthority: A destination Astral site must provide explicit projection-admission permission, safe arrival cells, physical and environmental rules, and a movement map. This spell does not create general planar access, define every destination site, or imply onward gate or teleport permission.

identity.actor: one stable actor ID, one current/maxHP/Wounds/death, RP, inventory, charges, Action/BonusAction/Reaction, movement, concentration, class history and rest ledger
identity.bodies: original physical body remains at its actual location; a spell-owned projection expression appears at the declared Astral arrival cell; it has the same shape/anatomy and ordinary senses, not a second actor
identity.control: only projection is voluntarily controlled; original body is dormant but physically vulnerable, needs continue, no free rest or healing
identity.damage: Damage at either body settles on the single actor ledger. For a single damage-root that legally reaches both, apply the greatest eligible post-defense loss once (ties by stable body ID), not twice; distinct independent roots remain distinct.
identity.zero: ordinary zeroHP state and callbacks still apply; immediately terminate that actor's projection and return control to its original body before its next action, without healing/stabilization or erased pending death saves
identity.death: death/destruction at either locus resolves once on the actor and original remains; projection vanishes with no second corpse/soul; no rescue from a valid Hunt or other terminal source

gear.original: real worn/carried gear remains physically with the original body and retains original ownership/custody
gear.proxy: one nonlootable source-owned use proxy per actual equipped item at projection; exact current authoritative item state is checked before every use. A stolen, destroyed, expended or unequipped original instantly invalidates its proxy
gear.costs: ammo/charges/consumables spent through a proxy debit the original item once at use commitment; no duplicate source trigger or retrievable proxy ammunition
gear.components: a still-valid legal focus proxy can supply F as this new projection permission; original V/S ability is expressed by projection, with ordinary hands/components requirements; silence or incapacitation at the actual casting locus still matters
gear.newAstralItems: genuine items picked up in Astral have their own physical custody, mass and support. They are not proxied into the original plane. On individual return put down/drop them at their exact Astral position, settle support/fall, and retain owners. No unapproved cross-plane import.

canonicalProcedure.movementAndActions: Projection walks using the actor's actual current speed and supported body paths; no inherent flight, phasing or unrestricted navigation. It can manipulate supported Astral objects, fight or legally cast using the one actor budget. Original body cannot act simultaneously. A message to another plane needs its own actual source.

lifecycle.printedInstantaneous: initiation of new finite projection expressions
lifecycle.deadline: successful resolution+3600000ms for all original participants; no reset on save/load
lifecycle.individualReturn: participant spends one actual Action to end only its own expression; control returns to original body wherever that body actually is. No movement of original body, freeing restraints, healing, duplicated inventory or return-to-old-coordinate fiction
lifecycle.cohort: other participants keep original deadline and can act even if caster returns or dies; no second cast/deadline created
lifecycle.suppression: if an accepted provider covers a participant's relevant projection expression or source anchor, safely terminate that individual projection; return is terminal, never suspended-and-revived. Provider scope and geometry must be real
lifecycle.dispel: eligible rank9 ending terminates affected expression(s) exactly once, not unrelated cohort
lifecycle.recast: known already-projected actor is rejected at admission; a later new cast after actual return costs full resources and creates new source
lifecycle.lostOriginal: stable body location/identity is authoritative. Moving/confined original receives control in place. If destroyed, settle actual death/terminal source. Missing data is an error, not permission to fabricate a safe body/site
lifecycle.cargoEnding: genuine Astral items remain at supported Astral exit coordinates or undergo ordinary fall; projections/proxies end without loot

Willing target may explicitly decline. No forced confinement for unsupported/partial/colliding formation; known illegal geometry fails before commitment, newly invalid geometry after commitment fails paid.

commonCell.innerBounds: target current whole body plus carried equipment AABB, expanded1ft in X/Y and1ft above. Floor stays at original feetZ and uses an existing continuous supported floor; no slab is inserted through terrain.
commonCell.walls: four side panels thickness0.5ft and one ceiling thickness0.5ft, outside the inner bounds. Allocate corners to X-panels; Y-panels span only inner X to avoid positive-volume overlaps. Each panel has a stable source-owned ID, exact AABB and independent HP where relevant.
commonCell.needs: air/light/sound pass; no oxygen, food, water, sleep or aging suspension. Body retains awareness, hands/components, equipment, actions, needs, injury and death processes. It is not stunned or deprived of its whole Action.
commonCell.boundary: solid against ordinary movement and objects while active; no new anti-teleport, anti-planar or anti-incorporeal privilege beyond the chosen creature admission. Any external escape ability must satisfy its own permission.
commonCell.privacy: cell is visible; private release keys/mental content are not disclosed by exterior inspection

STONE_VAULT.panelDamage: ordinary source-authorized object damage; no automatic immunity or resistance
STONE_VAULT.escape: a creature/helper spends actual attack/tool Actions with range and LoE. A destroyed panel is permanently absent, opening that exact region; it is not regenerated. Whole-body fit through the gap still required.
STONE_VAULT.substance: source-owned conjured stone, rank9 ongoing expression; no loot or reusable mineral value; fragments are source-owned nonrecoverable residue and vanish at source ending

SIGIL_CELL.physicalDamage: not a physical destructible object; ordinary attacks cannot damage its magical boundary
SIGIL_CELL.escape: imprisoned actor spends one Action for one WIS save vs original cast DC; three successes cumulatively terminate the source, failures do not erase successes. Helpers may perform actual eligible rank9 dispel or use the source's registered release key; no free check each turn.
SIGIL_CELL.key: At declaration, the caster names one finite, explicit release condition that the target knows. The target can satisfy it only by taking the named action. No secret knowledge is inferred.

lifecycle.printedInstantaneous: formation only; NEW continuing prison expression with finite deadline
lifecycle.ownerLoss: source survives caster incapacity/death until existing ending/deadline; owner may dismiss using one Action if alive and able, no distance or plane communication override beyond same-plane known source ID
lifecycle.endings: 24-hour elapsed deadline, lawful release, eligible source ending or all panels destroyed. Ending removes only prison matter/expressions; target and genuine gear remain at their actual current location. No corpse disappearance or resurrection.
lifecycle.growth: if a legitimate body change would overlap active prison panels, end prison before settling the changed body; never crush or cancel another legal form silently
lifecycle.suppression: only covered panels inactive; original deadline continues. On resumption, if any panel volume is occupied, end the entire prison safely instead of inserting it through bodies/items. Destroyed/ended panels never resume.
lifecycle.recast: same-target active source known at admission rejects another prison of this identity before cost. Different owners do not bypass that guard; race revalidated at paid resolution. Separate external effects remain independent.
lifecycle.escapeAfterOpening: target moves using its real movement budget and swept fit; ending creates no free step, Action or rescue teleport
lifecycle.death: original corpse and gear remain where death occurred; the cell may continue but never claims a soul or reusable summoned corpse

canonicalProcedure.admission: Choose exactly one QUESTION or TASK operation at declaration. Bind the caster’s actual selected faith and recipient relationship and the recipient’s permission to answer or perform the operation. Do not infer universal omniscience, create a deity, or infer a deity genealogy.

question.operation: One finite question to the bound recipient; output one useful supported answer with precision and provenance permitted by that recipient's knowledge/disclosure policy.
question.subject: declared known question subject and any actual spatial targets must satisfy the native120ft/LoE contract; addressing the bound recipient is the spell's new contact operation, not general cross-plane travel/scrying permission
question.privacy: caster privately learns only approved fields; protected, unavailable or unknown yields the same No answer available. No hidden diagnosis, private roster inference or certainty beyond evidence.
question.repeat: new paid cast may ask again; same-key callback grants no second answer/history/cost. Existing ordinary acquired memory persists through later dispel. No three-question Commune copy, long-rest charge or Saint cooldown is imported.

task.benefit: Restore a useful mundane bridge from a complete blueprint and owned, available compatible material stock. This is a substantive instantaneous miraculous assembly, not a borrowed lower-spell slot.
task.targets: all source material and every changed structure cell are perceived/known with clear LoE and within120ft; finite enumerated source IDs, versioned quantities, owner consent and exact support geometry are mandatory
task.preflight: verify materials, profiles/density, permitted blueprint, support loads, empty construction volumes and no protected or occupied matter; unknown ownership is not permission
task.settlement: stage all changes then compare versions and atomically consume material, form the exact structure, preserve provenance/ownership and register stable result IDs. Actual eligible defenses or changed conditions after commitment cause paid failure with no partial physical output.
task.aftermath: ordinary physical structure with explicit durability/support remains; no continuing miracle, free repairs, maintenance ward or dispel reversal. Subsequent damage and custody are normal. A duplicate transaction cannot duplicate material.

canonicalProcedure.designDecision: A versioned finite outcome registry supplies substantive reality changes and one substantial composite. These examples do not define Wish’s maximum possible power. Additional outcomes require their own explicit design, version, and validation; the registered outcomes do not grant blanket permission. No D&D spell-copy ceiling, gold cap, stress, Strength drain, spell-loss chance, extra material price, or cooldown is imported.
canonicalProcedure.admission: Select an exact registered outcome and complete finite argument graph. All affected bodies/items/source and destination geometry must be within120ft and satisfy the selected LoE/permission rules. Known impossible/unregistered/prohibited declarations are rejected before commitment; hidden defenses/changed versions discovered after commitment are paid failures with no refund.

WISH-MATERIAL-RESHAPE-01.operation: Instantaneously change owned nonliving mundane material into a specified mundane material and shape, conserving exact total mass for this outcome; this is not a global Wish conservation limit.
WISH-MATERIAL-RESHAPE-01.inputs: source IDs, quantities, material/density, owner consent, output blueprint/density/volume and unoccupied supported destination cells
WISH-MATERIAL-RESHAPE-01.exclusions: living tissue, souls, unique relic identity/protected components, knowledge/history and resource pools are not authorized by this outcome
WISH-MATERIAL-RESHAPE-01.result: new physical geometry/material with one lineage graph and original ownership. Source quantities are consumed exactly once; no ongoing magic or free reversion.

WISH-STRUCTURE-RECONSTRUCT-01.operation: Reconstruct a finite damaged mundane structure from its exact authorized blueprint and real compatible mass, including its support graph and exact durability. It may use the staged output of MATERIAL-RESHAPE in the same composite.
WISH-STRUCTURE-RECONSTRUCT-01.rules: validate all source/target/support versions and full empty-volume fit. No restoring consumed unique resources, reviving destroyed relic powers or inferring an unavailable blueprint. Completed construction is ordinary physical aftermath.

WISH-WILLING-RELOCATE-01.operation: Instantaneously relocate a finite explicitly enumerated set of willing living corporeal creatures and their currently declared carried items between exact cells on the same plane. No fixed participant-count cap; every body and its complete cargo envelope must be enumerated and independently fit.
WISH-WILLING-RELOCATE-01.consent: each creature explicitly consents at commitment and settlement; each moved independent owned item has lawful custody/owner permission
WISH-WILLING-RELOCATE-01.geometry: both original and destination complete bounds within120ft with clear LoE from caster; destination supported and pairwise nonoverlapping; actual anti-teleport/source protections remain effective
WISH-WILLING-RELOCATE-01.cost: caster's paid Wish supplies the relocation; no recipient movement cost or extra Action is fabricated, and no recipient budget is refreshed
WISH-WILLING-RELOCATE-01.preserve: actor identity, HP/Wounds/death history, current RP, concentration, existing elapsed clocks, item ownership/charges and all prior movement spent; process actual range-dependent effect callbacks once

composite.transaction: One cast, one Action, one actual final RP price; stage every node against a versioned projected state, validate all nodes and protections, then atomically commit the entire graph. No partially built bridge or moved participant exists if any node fails. The dependency graph is evidence, not three free new spell casts.
composite.failure: Known-invalid graph refused at admission. Counterspell/changed consent/version/occupied endpoint after commitment leaves all original world nodes untouched and preserves cast costs/history. Staging rollback is distinct from audit inverse of the full paid branch.
composite.deduplication: castID:operationGraphHash is the transaction key; receipt-first repeat returns original result with no second quantities, relocation, procs, memory or cost. Concurrent distinct casts race via version checks, never last-writer duplication.
composite.ongoingOrDeferred: None in these three outcomes. Save/load or later dispel does not rewind physical results. Future outcome versions must explicitly define any ongoing or deferred source, deadline and terminal ordering.

canonicalProcedure.extensionPolicy: A future registered substantive Wish outcome is allowed to exceed these examples if separately and explicitly authored; this package neither claims unlimited success nor imposes these examples as native power ceilings. Existing Hunt, time/history, uniqueness and source-protection qualifications remain.
